subject: executor: support anti semi join (#57971)
summary: Enables HashJoinV2 for `logicalop.AntiSemiJoin` (planner `CanUseHashJoinV2`) and adds HashJoinV2 executor support via a dedicated anti-semi probe plus shared semi/anti result-copy helpers. Reviewed join semantics (NOT EXISTS / NOT IN null handling via `VecEvalBool`), left-build scan-row-table path, right-build output path, and spill interactions; also scanned later history up to `upstream/master` for follow-up fixes. No remaining Blocker/High issues found.
